---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an OLLITERATOR feature or design change
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem should this change solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior.

## Safety impact

Explain whether the proposal changes any authorization predicate, hardware
profile semantics, candidate selection rule, destructive operation,
containment boundary, installer handoff, or prosecution requirement.

## Failure behavior

What should OLLITERATOR do when the new behavior is uncertain, incomplete, or
ambiguous?

## Hardware implications

Does this require a new or changed hardware profile?

If so, describe the hardware class and expected prosecution work.

## Additional context

Include any other useful technical context.

A feature that requires OLLITERATOR to guess which device it may destroy is
not compatible with the project safety model.
